idea: Find the longest run of numbers that keeps growing when read from left to right, skipping any numbers in between. For each position, L is one more than the best L among the earlier positions that hold a smaller number. The position with the largest L ends the answer, and the saved previous positions let you walk back to read it.
time: O(n^2) here (O(n log n) with a smarter search)
useWhen: Finding the longest rising trend inside a noisy list
Problems that ask how many items can be kept in order, such as stacking boxes
avoidWhen: The list is very long: the O(n log n) method is much faster
Equal numbers must count as rising: this version needs strictly bigger numbers
